PORTABLE VECTORXR BACKEND

Architecture: LMU -> LMU quad-view adapter -> VectorXR -> active OpenXR runtime.
The adapter renders four views. VectorXR supplies their view configuration and
composes them for the runtime. Select one software quad-view provider per launch.

Install VectorXR separately: https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr
VectorXR is not bundled. Enable its Quadviews profile for Le Mans Ultimate.exe.
In this launcher's Rendering page, select VectorXR. Setup autodetects standard
64-bit installations; use its VectorXR manifest selector for other locations.
Keep the headset's OpenXR runtime active. Quest with Virtual Desktop can use VDXR.

VectorXR owns resolution, focus dimensions and tracking settings. Configure them
in its app; QVFR-specific sliders are disabled while VectorXR is selected. Choose
Fixed when gaze tracking is unavailable. Auto requests tracking only when the
provider reports the required support. Restart LMU after changing launch settings.

The launcher's Focus position controls remain available with VectorXR. They add
horizontal/vertical offsets in Fixed and Auto without changing VectorXR's size
or resolution. Positive means right/up, negative left/down; units are percent of
the full projected view, from -50 to +50. Auto keeps following gaze. Reset offsets
restores zero. Large offsets may place part of the box outside the visible view.
Save and restart LMU to apply. Offsets are applied by the mod, not its provider.

The launcher creates an explicit provider manifest for this game process using
the original provider DLL path. It does not rewrite installed manifests or global
OpenXR registration. Duplicate implicit providers and conflicting Toolkit layers
are disabled only for the launched game. No Toolkit overlay is required.

Eligible single-sample 2D color swapchains request sampled usage so VectorXR can
use them directly. Other swapchain metadata is preserved. Unsupported sampled
requests retry the original usage; fatal errors are propagated. Provider logs can
confirm whether direct inputs are used. This capability does not guarantee a
particular frame-time gain or alter LMU's separate per-eye scene draws.

Setup -> Enable diagnostics and logging controls this mod's logs and profiling.
Untick and relaunch for normal play without mod diagnostics. The preference is
saved; old logs are retained. VectorXR and runtime logging have separate controls.
Necessary per-process manifests still exist under runtime/ with diagnostics off.
For measurements, re-enable diagnostics and follow RENDER-PROFILING.txt.
